text:
Nina S: FYI NordGrid (EU) returned the order form but procurement redlined an AML/UBO clause and their e-sign bounced. They want PO net30 + supplier UBO disclosure at signing.
Tom H: Envelope id `env_1b7c9d` got failure: recipient verification flagged. Customer says they can't move forward until countersigned.
Ewa L (Customer): Sorry for the delay — procurement flagged AML. Can we get this wrapped today? POC needs to start Mon.
DocsAdmin Bot: Delivery failure: envelope `env_1b7c9d` rejected (recipient verification: "UBO_REQUIRED"). See https://docusign.example/envelopes/env_1b7c9d
Tom H: Can someone paste their redline? I only have a screenshot.
Nina S: Pasting the clause they added: "Upon execution Seller shall disclose ultimate beneficial owners and provide AML reports within five (5) business days."
Priya V (Legal): UBO disclosure at signing is not standard for us. We can offer AML attestations + onboarding checks. If procurement insists we need legal to trade the language.
Carlos M (Finance): Net30 for a $18k POC — Finance can approve with a one-off. Need quote id and PO number when sent.
Nina S: Quote `Q-2026-8811`. Customer draft PO `PO-NG-778`.
Priya V (Legal): Proposed replacement language: "Seller will provide commercially reasonable AML documentation as part of onboarding. Disclosure of ultimate beneficial owners will be provided only if required by applicable law or regulatory request." Also propose to preserve DPA/SCC references.
ProcureBot: Reminder: vendor onboarding requires bank attestation + W-8 / VAT as applicable.
Ewa L (Customer): Procurement says they need a clause in the order form; they won't accept separate onboarding steps. Is a narrow amendment acceptable?
Tom H: Ops note: DocuSign triggers can be adjusted. We can send envelope with email-only verification to unblock signature, then collect AML docs in onboarding. That worked with SignalCo last quarter.
Priya V (Legal): I'll prepare a one-page amendment that: 1) replaces the UBO clause with the onboarding language, 2) adds the net30 PO line for `PO-NG-778`, 3) confirms existing DPA/SCCs stay intact. I'll share draft here in ~2 hours.
Carlos M (Finance): Fine with net30 once amendment attached to PO. Finance will mark as exceptions-approved for this vendor.
Nina S: Customer requested we also include an acceptance window: POC kickoff contingent on countersign but we can provisionally schedule.
Priya V (Legal): Draft below — please review and edit quickly:
```
Amendment to Order Form
1) The following sentence in the Order Form is deleted: "Upon execution Seller shall disclose ultimate beneficial owners..." and is replaced with: "Seller shall provide commercially reasonable AML documentation during onboarding. Disclosure of ultimate beneficial owners will be provided only if required by law."
2) Payment Terms: Net 30 for PO `PO-NG-778` (Amount: EUR 16,800).
3) All other terms, including the DPA and SCCs, remain unchanged.
```
Tom H: LGTM. Nina pls re-create envelope with email-only verification and attach this amendment + original quote.
Nina S: Pinged `docs-admin@redwood.ai` to reserve admin slot.
DocsAdmin Bot: Admin note: to avoid ID checks, create envelope with recipientAuth = "email" and include amendment as separate attachment. Contact ops-docs if you need help.
Ewa L (Customer): Thanks team — procurement will review the amendment. We'll try to circulate PO internally today.
Priya V (Legal): I'll send final PDF to `docs-admin@redwood.ai` and cc `ewa@nordgrid.eu` when ready. Expect outbound in ~3h.
Carlos M (Finance): Once countersigned, finance please send setup details to procurement for vendor token.
Nina S: Will update timeline to customer: tentative kickoff Mon, confirmed upon countersign.
Tom H: Closing loop: tag me if DocuSign returns any other flags.
